fixtures.research_scope: Enumerate every primary randomized salt-reduction or salt-substitution trial that the supplied review identifies as eligible. Each primary trial is one row. Do not create rows for the review, protocols, observational registries, or named substudies.

source_documents.title: Evidence synthesis of dietary sodium intervention trials
source_documents.text: Eligible randomized trials were Changzhi (later called the Changzhi salt-substitute trial), TONE, DECIDE-Salt, the Salt Substitute and Stroke Study (SSaSS), and the China Rural Health Initiative Sodium Reduction Study (CRHI-SRS). The renal substudy of SSaSS and the DECIDE-Salt protocol are discussed separately but are not additional randomized trials. PURE-Sodium is an observational registry and was excluded.

fixtures.research_scope: Create one row for each original study explicitly designated as a landmark foundation of modern portfolio theory in the excerpt. Exclude the review itself, later replications, authors as separate entities, and methods that are not studies.

source_documents.title: Seventy years of portfolio theory: a review
source_documents.text: This review treats three original works as the landmark foundations: Harry Markowitz's 1952 article 'Portfolio Selection'; James Tobin's 1958 article 'Liquidity Preference as Behavior Towards Risk'; and William F. Sharpe's 1964 article 'Capital Asset Prices: A Theory of Market Equilibrium under Conditions of Risk'. The efficient frontier and separation theorem are concepts, not additional works. A 2019 replication of Markowitz and the present 2020 review are not counted as foundational originals.

source_documents.title: Official urban rail roster, status at 31 December 2019
source_documents.text: Operational systems — Aster Metro: opened 2012; 2019 passenger-km 480 million. Boreal Urban Rail (also Boreal Metro): opened 2016; 2019 passenger-km NR. Cygnus Line: Phase 1 opened to the public on 30 December 2019; 2019 passenger-km 12 million. Planned / not operational at cutoff — Dorado Metro: trial operation began 10 January 2020. The Aster Transit Authority and Boreal Municipal Transport Bureau are operators, not metro systems.

source_documents.title: Two busiest systems in the region
source_documents.text: Aster and Cygnus led reported passenger-kilometres. Boreal was omitted because its value was not reported.
